The '''Quesh Republic Orbital Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War|subsequent renewed conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Quesh Orbital Station for the Imperial faction was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as the spaceport for Imperial players for the planet Quesh, and can only be accessed by players with their own ship.
